data.summary: Scrum Master and Agile Coach with 7+ years leading Agile delivery for US Healthcare organizations, including 4+ years in SAFe environments coordinating Agile Release Trains. Facilitates PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives; partners with Product Owners on backlog health and prioritization; and removes cross-team impediments using Jira, Confluence, and Agile metrics (Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time) to keep delivery predictable. Background in QA and Test Engineering adds a quality-first lens to sprint execution.
languages: Certificate: SAFe 6.0 (PI Planning, ART Sync, Inspect & Adapt, Innovation & Planning)

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Facilitates PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives; partners with Product Owners on backlog health and prioritization; and removes cross-team impediments using Jira, Confluence, and Agile metrics (Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time) to keep delivery predictable. Background in QA and Test Engineering adds a quality-first lens to sprint execution.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Scrum & Kanban Facilitation, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Scrum Ceremonies • SAFe Agile Framework, PI Planning & PI Objectives, Program Increment (PI) Execution, Agile Release Train (ART) Coordination
Dependency & Risk Management, Impediment Removal, Stakeholder Management • Agile Metrics & Reporting (Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time), Continuous Improvement & Retrospectives • Jira, Confluence, Agile Coaching, Program Coordination, US Healthcare Domain
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Scrum Master — Lead Consultant | Virtusa Consulting ServicesOct 2021 – Present Client: Healthcare Claims Processing | Domain: US Healthcare
Facilitate SAFe ceremonies — PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives — for a healthcare claims processing program.
Coach teams on SAFe, Scrum, and Lean-Agile practices, raising delivery maturity across the Agile Release Train (ART). • Partner with Product Owners on backlog prioritization, refinement, and PI Objective definition to keep scope aligned to business priorities.
Identify and manage impediments, risks, and cross-team dependencies within the ART to protect sprint and PI commitments.
Coordinate ART activities and support PI execution across multiple cross-functional teams. • Track Agile/SAFe metrics — Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time, and PI progress — to surface trends and guide continuous improvement.
Support release planning and Agile transformation initiatives using Jira and Confluence.
Scrum Master — Senior Project Engineer | Wipro TechnologiesDec 2019 – Oct 2021 Client: Health Plan Services | Domain: US Healthcare
Led end-to-end Scrum delivery, consistently meeting Sprint Goals, commitments, and quality objectives. • Facilitated all Scrum ceremonies, building a focused, collaborative, and high-performing team environment. • Served as servant leader and Agile coach, guiding teams toward self-organization and delivery accountability. • Proactively identified and removed impediments, managing risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies to sustain delivery momentum.
Partnered with Product Owners on backlog refinement, prioritization, story readiness, and value-driven delivery. • Facilitated estimation, capacity planning, and sprint forecasting to improve predictability and delivery confidence. • Used Agile metrics — Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time, Lead Time — to identify trends and improve team performance. • Converted retrospective insights into measurable improvement actions, championing continuous improvement. • Strengthened stakeholder collaboration and transparency through consistent progress reporting and delivery updates. • Led cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects on time and within budget.
QA Lead — Senior QA Lead | Wipro TechnologiesJan 2015 – Dec 2019 Client: Alight Solutions | Domain: Insurance
Led testing activities and managed resources to ensure timely project delivery. • Gathered requirements and developed use cases, specifications, test plans, and defect reports for comprehensive test coverage.
Mentored junior team members to strengthen team skills and overall performance. • Validated user requirements to improve customer satisfaction.
Test Engineer | Wipro TechnologiesJul 2012 – Jan 2015 Client: Standard Bank of South Africa | Domain: Banking
Executed functional and integration test cases to validate software quality and enhance user experience. • Collaborated with Business Analysts and Developers to clarify requirements and resolve defects efficiently. • Tracked defects and maintained test documentation to support project transparency. • Mentored junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional development.
